title: Muse AQBC prefix-store run
purpose: Add prefix-state reuse to the accepted AQB image and measure AQBC and cache-off AQB behavior in one capped load, preserving the Run 1 weights, binary, router and published baseline.

covers: Run 1 AQB by pinned artifact identity
Same-load AQB control and AQBC hardware evidence

prompt_512.description: Fixed text that renders to 512 tokens with the Muse no-thinking chat template.

prompt_2048.description: Fixed text that renders to 2048 tokens with the Muse no-thinking chat template.

mmlu_test.description: MMLU (Hendrycks et al.) data.tar from https://people.eecs.berkeley.edu/~hendrycks/data.tar; the test split, 57 subjects, 14,042 questions.

arms.summary: Published Run 1 mixed pack and prefill reference; the live control is cache off in the same capped load.
AQB plus prefix-store request policy and SWA checkpoints.
deviations: cache_prompt true for candidate follow-up pairs

client_ttft_ms.how: Client clock from sending the request to the first streamed token.

decode_tokens_per_second.how: Generated tokens after the first, over the time they took, from the server's timings.

request_total_ms.how: Client clock from sending the request to the last streamed token (32 generated tokens).

prompt_tokens_per_second.how: Prompt tokens over prompt processing time, from the server's timings.

sampled_peak_memory_bytes.how: Highest sampled resident memory of the engine process group under the cap.

load_seconds.how: From engine start to the health endpoint answering ready.

protocol.notes: One capped server load. Standard cold and warm requests, matched follow-up pairs with cache on and off, coherence smoke and 250 paired MMLU cases. The published AQB arm cites Run 1.

checks.does: The candidate returns coherent text for the pinned workload.
Same-load cache-off controls provide the first-request and follow-up comparison.
Server logs show restored prefix state for both prompt sizes and the candidate lowers follow-up TTFT.
Retain the paired results for the same 250 MMLU questions and seed.

rules: Delivery requires accepted factory-stage digests, allowlisted configuration changes, and memory budget verification.
Release requires measured cache hits and follow-up TTFT gains at 512 and 2048 tokens against same-load cache-off controls.
Record first-request speed and the paired accuracy check. Keep runtime refusals and raw evidence.

execution.notes: The graph measurement node runs one machine-gated 96 GiB cgroup with no swap.

notes: Run 1 published A and AQB retain their original provenance. The live AQB control is measured in the same AQBC load with cache_prompt false.
Owner instruction 002 adopted prefix store and retained the refused placement candidate. Instruction 003 required same-load comparison.

nodes.objective: Verify the identities of the Run 1 AQB image, binary, mixed pack and prefill plan.

outputs.name: pinned_inputs
criteria: Verify each operator-pinned SHA-256, cross-check the image and executable identities, and retain the pack manifest census without rereading the shards.

slots.from: Bind all the named helpful capsules to carry out and check this node under its authority ceiling.

briefing.summary: Verify the identities of the Run 1 AQB image, binary, mixed pack and prefill plan.
how_to_fill: Bind engine.kv_reuse_lab. Call factory.node_check.start for pinned_inputs. Supply refs.evidence_ids with operator_input records or prior-* artifacts for image_receipt, image_check, pack_manifest and batch_plan. The host pins the verifier spec; omit verifier_inputs.
The host seals the successful verifier output as an artifact. Cite the passing node_check in the plan update.

nodes.objective: Choose the prefix reuse launch settings and record the measured placement candidate refusal.

outputs.name: prefix_plan
criteria: Use Phase 0b cache-hit evidence, preserve AQB flags except the prefix-store additions and stay within 110000 MiB with the 96 GiB cgroup cap. Retain the measured Phase 0 share alternatives and why placement was refused.

slots.from: Bind all the named helpful capsules to carry out and check this node under its authority ceiling.

briefing.summary: Choose the prefix reuse launch settings and record the measured placement candidate refusal.
how_to_fill: Bind engine.kv_reuse_lab. Call factory.node_check.start for prefix_plan with refs.evidence_ids naming the accepted pin_inputs check and the phase and placement records. Omit verifier_inputs; the host reads the accepted sealed pinned_inputs.
Read the sealed prefix_plan artifact returned by the check. It carries the ready factory.builder request and the actual candidate settings.

nodes.objective: Package the same AQB executable in a config-only image and verify its factory-stage invariants.

outputs.name: image
criteria: The factory builder recorded one successful config-only image build whose base is the pinned AQB image and which retains the executable bytes.

outputs.name: factory_stage
criteria: The verified image preserves binary and pack identity, changes only approved prefix-store settings and fits the device budget with the 96 GiB runtime cap.

slots.from: Bind all the named helpful capsules to carry out and check this node under its authority ceiling.

briefing.summary: Package the same AQB executable in a config-only image and verify its factory-stage invariants.
how_to_fill: Bind factory.builder and engine.kv_reuse_lab. Read prefix_plan from the predecessor check sealed_artifact. Submit prefix_plan.build_request unchanged to factory.builder.submit with node_id build_image and idem_key r9-config-image. End the turn while the attempt runs.

Read factory.builder result. Pass factory.node_check.start for image with refs {build_attempt_id,image_id}. Then start factory_stage with refs.evidence_ids including the image check and prefix_plan check. Omit verifier_inputs; the host reads the verified build record and plan.
Cite both passing checks and the build attempt in the plan patch. Record the sealed factory_stage artifact for delivery.

nodes.objective: Seal and send the verified AQBC configuration to the lab manager for measured release.

outputs.name: lab_package
criteria: The native lab request names the verified AQBC image, same-load AQB control, and the exact factory-stage artifact, and covers every runtime requirement.

slots.from: Bind all the named helpful capsules to carry out and check this node under its authority ceiling.

briefing.summary: Seal and send the verified AQBC configuration to the lab manager for measured release.
how_to_fill: Bind factory.lab_manager. Use draft_task with arm_subjects {AQB: aqbc, AQBC: aqbc}. Subjects: aqbc is a container_image, identity {id:<image_id>}, build_attempt_id from the accepted image check, transfer none; factory_stage is an artifact, identity {artifact_id:<sealed_artifact>}, transfer attach.
Compose the draft with node_id deliver_to_lab; then send with idem_key r9-aqbc-lab. The mailbox route parks the request for the graph measurement node.
Check lab_package with refs {request_id:<sent request id>}. Cite the passing check. Sending the request does not authorize or start a GPU job.

nodes.objective: Measure the standard prompts, follow-up reuse, same-load controls and paired MMLU on one capped server.

outputs.name: measurements
criteria: One capped load produced complete raw records; evaluate same-load first-request speed, follow-up TTFT gain and logged prefix reuse at both sizes, coherent output and the 250-case MMLU comparison.

slots.from: Bind all the named helpful capsules to carry out and check this node under its authority ceiling.

briefing.summary: Measure the standard prompts, follow-up reuse, same-load controls and paired MMLU on one capped server.
how_to_fill: Bind factory.capped_runner and engine.kv_reuse_lab. Wait for operator release of the measure_engine step. Submit factory.capped_runner.start once with recipe muse_r9_measure, args {request_id:<accepted delivery request id>}, node_id measure_engine, idem_key r9-measure-engine.
Immediately end the turn after submitting the durable job. The controller parks while it runs. Do not poll in the same turn, start a second server or use separate model loads for MMLU.

After the job ends, read capped_runner.status and the host capped_run observation. Start node_check for measurements with refs.evidence_ids naming that observation. Omit verifier_inputs; the host binds the attempt and sealed request itself.
After a passing check cite the check and actual model_run attempt when marking the node done. A runtime refusal blocks release; preserve the reported measurements and check.

nodes.objective: Issue a release verdict gated on the accepted factory stage, delivery and runtime result.

outputs.name: release
criteria: Release only from the host check that links the accepted factory-stage evidence and lab package to the passing runtime-stage measurements.

slots.from: Bind all the named helpful capsules to carry out and check this node under its authority ceiling.

briefing.summary: Issue a release verdict gated on the accepted factory stage, delivery and runtime result.
how_to_fill: Bind factory.node_check. Start the release output check with refs {runtime_check_id:<accepted measurement node check id>}. Include the resulting release check in the release_gate plan update and the terminal accept decision.
If the hardware measurement checker refuses acceptance, preserve its evidence and report inconclusive; the graph may not mark the release gate done.
